title: pr-retro-hard aggregation input
description: Input contract for aggregate_review.py. Every enumeration here is CLOSED and carries no catch-all member: an unknown value is a hard error, never a defaulted value. aggregate_review.py is the decision owner; this file is its data shape, and the two are asserted consistent by test_aggregate_review.py.

draft_digest.description: Digest of the semantic content of the draft under review. A finding whose recorded draft_digest differs from this value is stale and is not applied.

packet_digest.description: Digest of the review packet the voices were given.

original_confidence.description: The lesson confidence before aggregation. Aggregation can only lower this, never raise it.

original_source.description: The lesson source label before aggregation. Aggregation never rewrites this to cross-model: mob voices read one draft through one prompt and are correlated by construction, so their agreement is not independent cross-model evidence.

enable_demotion.description: Whether a demotion recommendation is acted on. Defaults to false: the recommendation is always computed and reported, but shipping in shadow mode means it changes no tier.

voice_kind.description: adversarial findings never count toward consensus and are reported separately.

round.description: Consensus is established only by r1. r2 can refute, downgrade, withdraw, or supply a settling check, but never adds an independent vote.

target.description: What the finding is about, e.g. Q4 or lesson-<key> or rule-draft-2.

classification.description: Closed enumeration with no catch-all. UNSUPPORTED is the only classification that can produce a demotion recommendation, and only when its settling check is confirmed.

settling_check.description: A concrete check that would settle the finding: a command, a file:line reference, or a grep. The literal string (none) is a valid parsed value meaning no check was supplied.

draft_digest.description: The draft digest in force when this finding was produced. Compared against the top-level draft_digest to detect staleness.

check_state.description: Five distinct states. unable_to_execute is NOT refuted: invalid evidence does not establish that the claim is false.
